title: Over A Barrel
summary:
Sanctions against Venezuela are tightening
The situation in Venezuela is going from bad to worse. A recent article in Bloomberg mentioned that Venezuela currently produces only 374,000 barrels per day (b/d). To put this into perspective, this is a little more than 10% of the country's production 55 years ago according to the BP Statistical Review of World Energy 2020, which has oil production data going back to the 1960s.
